page.layout: One block of text at the top of the page, centred, about ten short lines, very faint and mostly unreadable. Below it, a small mark near the middle. Below that, a large engraved ornament (a triangular scroll-and-cartouche piece) occupies the centre of the page. No running head, page number or signature is visible.
page.notes: The top text block is too faded to read; the lines are given only by approximate length. The lower mark at the centre (about a third of the way down the page) is too faint to identify as a letter or numeral. The large central ornament is an engraved decorative piece in scrolls, with a face or mask near its upper middle and a pendant at its base; it has no printed words. The page is heavily stained and shows some show-through from the reverse side, which is not transcribed.
